stem:
Indu takes an ice cube from the freezer onto a warm plate. After a few minutes she has a puddle of liquid water.

Which description of the change is correct?

options.text: The ice melted: solid water changed into liquid water as it was warmed.
The ice changed from solid to liquid by evaporation.
The ice would melt even if the air around the plate were far below freezing.
Warming the liquid water on the plate would make it freeze back into ice.

teacher.key_rationale: Warming turns solid ice into liquid water by melting. Evaporation is liquid to vapour; freezing needs cooling.
